Help Center / Support / Streaming Guidelines
📢 Summary
Streaming, let's plays, clips, and monetization of this game are all allowed without prior permission.
Whether you are an individual or a company, we'd be glad if you share freely within the scope of these guidelines.

✅ What You Can Do Freely

Streaming and let's plays OK You can freely stream and do let's plays on any platform, including YouTube, Twitch, Niconico, X (Twitter), and TikTok.
Monetization (ads, Super Chats, etc.) OK All revenue from your videos and streams is yours. No prior permission or payment is required.
Clip videos OK Anyone, whether the original streamer or a third party, may freely create and publish clip videos.
* If you clip someone else's stream or video, we cannot take responsibility for any disputes with the original streamer or rights holder. Please also check the original streamer's rules and permissions.
Using screenshots OK You can freely use screenshots of the game for thumbnails, social media posts, blog articles, and more.
Paid streams and subscriber-only content OK Use in membership-only videos and subscription streams is fine too.
Use at tournaments and events OK You may use this game at contests and events, both online and offline.

🙏 Requests (Optional)

Credit

It isn't required, but including the game name and the Steam store page URL in your description or stream title helps viewers find the game, and we'd really appreciate it.

Example:
Game: Railway Dispatcher Pro
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4932180/

Social Media Hashtag

When posting on X (Twitter), TikTok, or similar, we'd be happy if you use #鉄道運行管理シミュレーターPro.

When the developer (@tadi_maru) finds your post, we may repost it or say hello.

⚠️ What You Must Not Do

Distributing or reposting the game files Not allowed Distributing or reposting the game's installation files, executable, or data on other sites is prohibited.
Modding and reverse engineering Not allowed Disassembling the game and distributing modified data are prohibited. Distribution of mods is also not supported at this time.
Use contrary to public order and morals Not allowed Use for discriminatory, defamatory, or illegal purposes is prohibited.
Impersonating the developer Not allowed Falsely claiming to be "official" or "developer-approved" (such as making it look as if a particular company or local government is a sponsor) is prohibited.

📋 For Companies and Large-Scale Streamers

These guidelines apply to individuals and companies alike. No prior application or individual contract is required.

However, if you are considering large-scale promotional use such as the following, we'd feel more at ease if you consult us first to avoid problems.

  • Use in TV programs or terrestrial broadcasts
  • Major projects at streaming events with an audience of 500,000 or more
  • Publications or merchandise based on this game
  • Use involving sponsorships or tie-ups
Contact: X DM @tadi_maru or the contact form

📝 Disclaimer

  • These guidelines may change without notice. Please refer to this page for the latest version.
  • The developer cannot take responsibility for any damage or disputes that streamers or viewers incur through use of this game.
  • If there is any question about how to interpret these guidelines, please contact the developer.

📮 Contact

Please send questions and requests to the following.
